profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Enthusiastic software engineer with over a decade of experience reliably delivering high-quality software in a number of industries and sectors.

I want to help build your next big idea without sacrificing quality, scalability, or development processes, and I want to do it while maintaining company culture and human empathy.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft Azure · Containerization · Kubernetes · .NET Core

positions.title: Principal Consultant
positions.description:
Software Developer at Technossus specializing in Microsoft stack technologies.  Experience writing enterprise software for medical, tech, and consumer companies.  

Sat onsite at SpaceX to improve a major enterprise system used to track defects and potential quality escapes in vehicle parts.

Worked on a Laboratory Information System (LIS) to streamline specimen collection, analysis, and processing at scale.  

Designed and implemented a component-based architecture to migrate a major medical provider's forward facing site and applications from an existing custom CMS to an industry standard enterprise solution.

positions.title: Enterprise Software Consultant
positions.description: Served as an enterprise software development consultant for SpaceX.  Worked on major internal systems and helped strengthen existing infrastructure while developing new features.

positions.title: Lead Application Developer
positions.description: Developed internal software which served University staff, faculty, and students.  Maintained existing software and developed new key systems that support everything from electronic signatures to HIPAA compliant health services to applications supporting various internal groups.
